abstract: STUDY OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the outcomes of laparoscopic surgery for the treatment of adnexal pathology in older children and adolescents. DESIGN: A retrospective cohort review. SETTING: A tertiary academic center in Istanbul, Turkey. PARTICIPANTS: Pediatric and adolescent patients aged between 9 and 19 years (n = 69) who underwent laparoscopic surgery for adnexal pathology from January 2005 through September 2015. The patients who were pregnant or with non-gynecologic pathology detected during surgery were excluded from the study. INTERVENTIONS: Patients were divided into 2 groups according to their age. Group 1 consisted of 31 patients aged between 9 and 16 years and group 2 included 38 patients aged between 17 and 19 years. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The indication for surgery, procedures performed, anesthesia time, length of hospital stay, pathology findings, and complication rates were evaluated. RESULTS: Ovarian cystectomy and adnexal detorsion with or without cystectomy were the most frequently performed. Ovary-sparing conservative surgery was possible for all patients, except those with gonadal dysgenesis and testicular feminization (n = 6), who underwent laparoscopic gonadectomy. The most common pathologic finding was mature cystic teratoma (30.2%), followed by benign paratubal cyst, and simple cysts of the ovary. Anesthesia time was shorter in group 2 (P = .018). The procedures performed, length of hospital stay, complication rate, and pathology findings were not significantly different between the 2 groups. CONCLUSIONS: Laparoscopic surgery can be successfully performed as an efficient, safe, and well tolerated procedure for treating a wide variety of adnexal pathology among children and young adolescents without any significant variation between different age groups.
abstract_ja: 研究目的：年長児および思春期患者の付属器病変に対する腹腔鏡手術の成績を評価すること。デザイン：後方視的コホート研究。設定：トルコ・イスタンブールの三次医療機関。対象：2005年1月から2015年9月までに付属器病変に対して腹腔鏡手術を受けた9〜19歳の小児および思春期患者（n = 69）。妊娠中の患者および手術中に婦人科以外の病変が発見された患者は除外した。介入：患者を年齢により2群に分けた。第1群は9〜16歳の31例、第2群は17〜19歳の38例であった。主要評価項目：手術適応、施行術式、麻酔時間、入院期間、病理所見、合併症率を評価した。結果：卵巣嚢胞摘出術および、嚢胞摘出の有無にかかわらず行われた付属器捻転解除が最も多く施行された。性腺異形成および精巣女性化症の患者（n = 6）を除く全例で卵巣温存保存的手術が可能であり、これらの患者は腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術を受けた。最も多い病理所見は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（30.2%）で、次いで良性傍卵管嚢胞、卵巣単純性嚢胞であった。麻酔時間は第2群で短かった（P = .018）。施行術式、入院期間、合併症率、病理所見は両群間で有意差がなかった。結論：腹腔鏡手術は、若年の小児および思春期患者における多様な付属器病変の治療において、効率的で安全かつ忍容性の高い方法として、年齢群による有意な差なく成功裏に実施できる。
